_comment: AI bot tuning. Difficulty profiles (angles in degrees, times in seconds):
reaction      time from first sight of an enemy until the bot starts to aim at it
turn_speed    maximum view rotation speed; snap = how quickly the view closes the gap
aim_error     initial aim offset when acquiring a target (shrinks at error_decay per second)
headshot      chance to aim at the head rather than the chest
spray_control fraction of the recoil pattern the bot compensates
fov           vision cone; hearing scales the distance at which footsteps/shots are heard
strafe        strafes between bursts; grenades = chance to use utility when the plan calls for it
The bots (server/src/ai/) use the same difficulty profiles (aim, reaction mean, fov, hearing) plus
path_budget   A* polygon expansions per team per tick (server/src/ai/pathing.ts)
radio         callouts: delay (s, lognormal median) clipped to delay_range, fuzz (m) of the
called position, batch (s) to merge calls into one line, miss = chance a call is lost
humanize      per difficulty, overrides of server/src/ai/humanize.ts DEFAULTS: reaction_sigma (lognormal
spread), tunnel (late reaction while busy), flick [mean, sd] (fraction of the turn),
stress_gain, decision_noise, mistake chances (over_peek, skip_corner, reload_open,
late_trade, ignore_call, panic) and radar_glance [min, max] seconds between glances
